t: Facing Big Ben across the road, at the western end of Westminster Bridge, is Boadicea and Her Daughters. This bronze group shows Boudica, the queen of the Iceni who led an uprising against Roman rule. It is considered the masterwork of Thomas Thornycroft, who worked on it from 1856 until shortly before his death in 1885, sometimes helped by his son Hamo. His wife Mary finished it, and it wasn't erected here until 1902. It became a rallying point for the women's suffrage movement. Thomas Graham Jackson designed the pedestal.
